newsitem.title: CHINA: China '97 aluminium output seen at 1.8 mln T.
newsitem.headline: China '97 aluminium output seen at 1.8 mln T.

text.p: China is expected to produce about 1.8 million tonnes of aluminium in 1997, the Economic Information Daily said on Friday.
China's aluminium output reached 1.693 million tonnes in 1996, up by 2.05 percent from 1995, official figures showed.
Domestic consumption of aluminium is expected to reach about 1.9 million tonnes in 1997, it said, quoting metal experts.
The average aluminium price in the domestic market is projected at between 15,500-16,000 yuan ($1,867-$1,928) per tonne in 1997, it said, but gave no further details.
